answer_1.quote: we propose a novel task, named Conversational Web Naviga-tion. It requires the multi-turn interaction capabilities with both users and environment.
answer_1.outputs: The agent generates action sequences in response to multi-turn user instructions during web navigation, involving natural language understanding and generation in a conversational setting.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the following metrics for evaluation: 1) Element Accuracy (Ele. Acc) matches the selected element with all required elements. 2) Operation F1 (Op. F1) stands for the token-level F1 score for the predicted operation. 3) Step Success Rate (SSR). 4) Turn Success Rate (TSR).
